description: Source code for the PackageManager class implementation, managing package operations, initialization, deinitialization, and event handling within a plugin framework.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: Implements package management functionalities including initialization, deinitialization, status updates, and deactivation handling within a plugin system.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the PackageManager with a given plugin host shell, setting up interfaces and registering notifications.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, releases interfaces, and terminates remote connections.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns package manager information string in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation, scheduling cleanup on a separate thread.

methods.name: OperationStatus
methods.description: Reports the status of a package operation, triggering an event.
